getAABB_body: get the axis-aligned bounding box min and max corners for a loaded URDF body in PyBullet
getAABB_joint: get the axis-aligned bounding box for a specific joint index on a PyBullet body
drawAABB_wireframe: draw a wireframe of an AABB using addUserDebugLine to visualize bounding box edges in the simulator
loadURDF_and_getAABB: load a URDF robot model and retrieve its overall and per-joint axis-aligned bounding boxes
stepSimulation_loop: run a continuous simulation loop with stepSimulation to keep the PyBullet GUI alive
